commands.name: mc
commands.description: Mission control: кто из агентов чем занят и почему; /mc close|clear|budget [+N]|halt|resume|solo

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: Процессы: долгие команды (скачивание, обучение, подготовка данных) с прогрессом; /jobs close|clear

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: mission-control state as JSON: agents (main and every subagent: phase, task, intent, current action, report), the activity feed, long jobs (background shells, long commands, monitors: kind, gist, who started them, progress parsed from their output), and the memory figures (settings-hook injections, CLAUDE.md tokens, mb search / mb code calls, turns, usage, vault alerts). Read-only.

tools.name: team
tools.description: The executors you delegated to, as a table: id, tier, effort, task, turns, OE spent (and the limit), state. Also the session OE budget, the Fable calls used, the news the digest has not delivered yet and the flags (frozen, solo, budget notices). Read-only: it does not clear the news.
